ctx.x: A little boy. You followed Mark Johnson. But when they gave me this cornet in the orphanage, I recalled all the things I had been listening to, and I loved the horn, and then by these same people teaching me how to read music, and I went errands, I run errands for Mrs. Oliver. And when he'd lay off, he thought I was good enough to play in his place. That's all right.
And when you got on the riverboats, what was the life like?
